readAnchors.needle: # A harness has at most ONE subscription.

products.name: Hermes Agent
products.features: Telegram and other messaging adapters; persistent profile/session state; searchable conversation history; memory; skill creation and maintenance; shell/background processes; browser tools; delegation; scheduled tasks; MCP; desktop/CLI/ACP/API surfaces.
products.distinction: A persistent assistant reachable from multiple channels, with learning as an explicit workflow. [Skills](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/features/skills), [Telegram team guide](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/guides/team-telegram-assistant). Public Python source is downloaded.

products.name: Warp
products.features: Live interactive terminal control; agents and children; local/cloud handoff; cross-harness orchestration; durable agent inboxes; waking finished agents; rules/skills/MCP; codebase context; plans; inline diff review; browser/computer QA and recordings.
products.distinction: Terminal sessions and coordinated execution are more consequential than simply exposing a shell command. [Agent overview](https://docs.warp.dev/agents/), [orchestration](https://docs.warp.dev/platform/orchestration/), [browser](https://docs.warp.dev/agents/capabilities/computer-use/browser-use/). Client source is public; built-in harness/cloud internals are not established by that checkout.

products.name: Codex
products.features: Interactive PTY tools; patch edits; subagent spawning, follow-up, messaging, waiting and interruption; skills/MCP/plugins/hooks; compaction; permission and sandbox controls; headless/app-server integration; desktop worktree/review workflows and integrated browser.
products.distinction: Browser is a desktop product capability, not a browser embedded in the public CLI. [Browser availability](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/browser), [product features](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/features). Public CLI/core source is downloaded; desktop/account services have separate boundaries.

products.name: Claude Code
products.features: Explicit file/read/search/edit tools; foreground/background shell work; notebook and LSP tools; custom subagents with scoped tools, models, skills and memory; worktree isolation; hooks/plugins/MCP; tasks; planning; scheduling; agent messaging.
products.distinction: Agent teams add shared tasks and direct teammate communication; teams remain experimental and disabled by default. [Tools](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference), [subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents), [teams](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams), [browser integration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/chrome). “Best tools” is a hypothesis requiring task-level tests, not a documentation finding.

products.name: Amp
products.features: Task and Read Thread subagents; difficulty modes; cross-thread context; plugins/skills/MCP; configurable provider connections; local runners; cloud Orbs; agent-to-agent instructions and file exchange; scheduled follow-ups; cross-device threads.
products.distinction: Current docs go beyond isolated helper returns: agents can delegate across projects and machines. Workspaces and files remain separate unless transferred. [Subagents](https://ampcode.com/docs/models-and-subagents), [agent-to-agent](https://ampcode.com/docs/orbs/agent-to-agent), [automations](https://ampcode.com/docs/orbs/automations), [connections](https://ampcode.com/docs/customize/model-routing). Proprietary core; docs-backed.

products.name: Factory / Droid
products.features: Custom droids; built-in worker/explorer; Missions with planning, milestones, workers and validators; automatic model routing; browser/desktop QA; headless execution; skills/plugins/hooks/MCP; code review; managed policies, sandbox and enterprise integrations.
products.distinction: Structured execution and validation deserve separate comparison from generic delegation. [Missions](https://docs.factory.com/missions/overview), [custom droids](https://docs.factory.com/harness/subagents), [Router](https://docs.factory.com/model-independence/factory-router). Public repo/docs do not expose the proprietary Droid core.

products.name: OpenClaw
products.features: Multi-channel gateway; per-agent personas and channel bindings; persistent sessions; session listing/history/send/spawn tools; child sessions and announcements; browser control; memory/search; durable schedules; goals; skills/plugins/MCP; remote control UI.
products.distinction: Gateway-owned routing and policy-controlled inter-session communication are central. [Session tools](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session-tool), [subagents](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents). Public implementation downloaded; capabilities vary with runtime and configuration.

products.name: Cline
products.features: Plan/Act; workspace read/search/edit and terminal tools; checkpoints; rules/skills/plugins/hooks/MCP; subagents; agent teams with task board/mailboxes; CLI connectors and scheduling; Kanban worktrees; desktop/IDE/CLI surfaces; ACP.
products.distinction: Different clients expose different features. Do not assign every CLI/team/connector capability to the VS Code extension. [CLI and feature navigation](https://docs.cline.bot/usage/cli-overview), [teams](https://docs.cline.bot/cli/agent-teams), [subagents](https://docs.cline.bot/features/subagents). Public source downloaded.

products.name: OpenCode
products.features: Multiple providers/models; Build/Plan primary agents; General/Explore/Scout helpers; agent-specific permissions; shell jobs; edit/patch/read; session history/revert; skills/plugins/hooks/MCP; web fetch/search; LSP integration; desktop/web/TUI/ACP interfaces.
products.distinction: Scout explicitly researches dependencies/external docs; Plan's label alone does not guarantee a read-only shell. [Agents and permission semantics](https://docs.opencode.ai/docs/agents/), [tools](https://docs.opencode.ai/docs/tools/). Public implementation downloaded.

products.name: OpenClaude (Twigpine)
products.features: Cloud/local provider profiles; per-agent model/provider routing and step limits; Bash/file/search tools; Agent helpers; addressable messages; background sessions/logs/kill; resume/fork; MCP/skills; optional repository maps; VS Code launch integration.
products.distinction: Distinct from OpenCode and official Claude Code. Team/peer/browser behavior has feature gates. Forking a chat does not create filesystem isolation; background `attach` currently points to logs rather than restoring a terminal. [Pinned README](https://github.com/Twigpine/openclaude/blob/e36580576278c27223b66ed3e9581186ea699161/README.md), [registered tools](https://github.com/Twigpine/openclaude/blob/e36580576278c27223b66ed3e9581186ea699161/src/tools.ts), [message schema](https://github.com/Twigpine/openclaude/blob/e36580576278c27223b66ed3e9581186ea699161/src/tools/SendMessageTool/SendMessageTool.ts).

products.name: Pi
products.features: Small coding-tool core; multi-provider SDK; extensible TypeScript tools/UI/hooks; branchable JSONL session trees; branch summaries and compaction; steering/follow-up queues; RPC/SDK; packages/skills/themes; Code Mode; deferred tool discovery; MCP.
products.distinction: A toolkit for composing a harness. The inspected coding-agent core does not establish built-in subagents/plan mode; extension or separate durable-package workflows must be labeled separately. [Pinned source/docs](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/tree/58c0b02ce552adab76014e7ed712ab7981359aa8/packages/coding-agent).

products.name: Gemini CLI
products.features: File/shell tools; web search/fetch; GEMINI.md; checkpoints/session resume; policies/sandbox; MCP/extensions/skills; investigator/generalist helpers; local/remote subagent machinery; browser specialist.
products.distinction: Browser is an opt-in experimental agent using bundled Chrome DevTools MCP and a separately available Chrome installation. [Subagents and browser prerequisites](https://geminicli.com/docs/core/subagents/), [core capabilities](https://geminicli.com/docs/core/). Public implementation newly downloaded.

products.name: Qwen Code
products.features: Subagents and context forks; team tasks/messages; background-agent continuation; automatic memory/skills; shell/edit/LSP; MCP/hooks; worktrees/approvals; desktop/web/IDE/chat clients; native Claude Code/Codex delegation; computer-use integration.
products.distinction: A much broader competitor than a Qwen-specific terminal wrapper. External executors have their own platform, continuation and permission limits. [Current subagent contracts](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/sub-agents/), [pinned README](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/949a71e29b022c6ccad1c505a49680b3a7ce41b2/README.md). Public implementation newly downloaded.

products.name: DeepSeek Harness
products.features: Plugin-composed agent loop; terminal/subagents; desktop and local web UI; plugin creation through chat; previews/artifacts; execution traces; browser runtime; experimental teams, shared task board, direct inboxes and scheduling.
products.distinction: This is a distinct public product, not merely using a DeepSeek model in another harness. Team docs explicitly limit cross-process coordination and separate working directories. [Product](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/), [pinned team contract](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/22ddee3792402c3e70ec5f86a63c3e3e895a2f60/packages/experimental/agent-team/README.md). Public source newly downloaded.

products.name: Goose
products.features: Local desktop/CLI/API; multiple model providers; MCP extensions; recipes and parameterized workflows; subrecipes; parallel subagents; persistent sessions; coding/general workflow tools; ACP provider integrations.
products.distinction: Recipes and delegated execution are useful integration units; calling Goose “static recipes only” misses its agent and subagent runtime. [Pinned source](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/tree/c3bfc5f7b0e230180ba3164ec1ee84fd951eaf0d), [subagent tutorial](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/blob/c3bfc5f7b0e230180ba3164ec1ee84fd951eaf0d/documentation/docs/tutorials/subagents.md). Newly downloaded.

products.name: Letta Code
products.features: Stateful agent identity; memory blocks and git-backed MemFS; skill learning; background memory worker; conversation recall; subagents; hooks/mods; messaging channels; heartbeats/crons; remote computers and cloud state.
products.distinction: Memory is an editable, versioned working system. Hosted state/remote-machine services must be separated from local execution. [Memory](https://docs.letta.com/configuration/memory), [pinned feature index](https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/blob/6c8b08fedfb6f3fb437163ede8320a387151693f/README.md). Public implementation newly downloaded.

products.name: Zed Agent
products.features: Native editor-aware agent; file/terminal tooling; subagent spawn and follow-up by session ID; model selection; profiles/rules/skills/MCP; inline edits and edit prediction; external ACP agents; terminal-backed agent threads.
products.distinction: Zed is both an agent and a host for other agents. An external agent retains its own runtime/auth/tools; its behavior is not automatically a native Zed feature. [AI paths](https://zed.dev/docs/ai/overview), [external agents](https://zed.dev/docs/ai/external-agents), [pinned delegation code](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/9f305aaf88370e8ca39c702242186e3d8f97ecca/crates/agent/src/tools/spawn_agent_tool.rs). Public editor source newly downloaded.

products.name: OpenHands
products.features: SDK/Agent Server; local or container/Kubernetes workspaces; shell/file/browser tools; delegated conversations; events and persisted state; REST/WebSocket interfaces; skills/plugins/MCP; browser-compatible TypeScript client.
products.distinction: Product UI, execution server, and automation are now distinct repositories. The downloaded SDK owns execution; scheduling/webhooks live in `OpenHands/automation`, which was not cloned in this pass. [Pinned architecture ownership](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/acd96e6fa424c02432304395b9208f99be24b54d/README.md), [delegation implementation](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/acd96e6fa424c02432304395b9208f99be24b54d/openhands-tools/openhands/tools/delegate/impl.py).

products.name: Pydantic AI Harness
products.features: Composable Coder/Researcher capabilities; typed tools and validated results; filesystem/persistent shell; memory; skills; isolated delegation with model menus/budgets; dynamic workflows; compaction; guardrails/judges; step persistence; durable-engine integrations; authored capabilities.
products.distinction: An embeddable framework, not directly the same product as a desktop coding app. Durable execution requires a selected engine; capability creation loads validated model-written code on a later run. [Capability map](https://pydantic.dev/docs/ai/capabilities/overview/), [pinned harness source](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/tree/4399efacd4755ff6feccc727d3180a97428e76cf). Newly downloaded.

products.name: Omnigent
products.features: Native multi-harness workers, CLI subscription login, Polly orchestration and cross-vendor review, tmux terminals, worktrees, policies, shared sessions and web/native/mobile clients.
products.distinction: No deterministic subscription-quota-triggered cross-harness handoff found in inspected paths; explicit fork, request retry, router-service fallback and supervisor replanning are different behaviors.

limitations: Source/doc observations do not certify runtime behavior or comparative quality
